ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a dominant central low-intensity (black) field comprising approximately 70-75% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized to the lateral lobe margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centrally contiguous black field. High-intensity white mottling is concentrated on the distal regions of both lobes. Left lobe (viewer's left) exhibits two distinct low-intensity circular voids within the white pixel cluster. Right lobe (viewer's right) shows a more diffuse, stippled white-to-black gradient.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped indentation with an acute angle and significant vertical depth relative to the horizontal fluke plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile. Multiple prominent peaks and valleys are detected along the continuous boundary, particularly on the inner margins flanking the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary trajectory is concave from the distal tips toward the median notch, with secondary small-scale convexities at the extreme lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct circular dark pigmentation clusters localized on the ventral white field of the left lobe. Additional reddish-brown high-contrast clusters are visible at the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, thin, high-intensity linear mark is visible on the left lobe (viewer's left), oriented diagonally across the white-pigmented area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Reddish-orange pixel clusters at the extreme tips of both lobes, indicative of localized parasitic colonization or physical trauma; irregular jagged indentation on the upper right trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'twin-spot' dark pigmentation pattern on the left lobe ventral surface.
